id: 06_Safety Prep For Tourists and Visitors Laser Safety at Laser Maintenance Group In
title: 做一个安全的参观向导（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/06_Safety Prep For Tourists and Visitors Laser Safety at Laser Maintenance Group In.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/06_Safety Prep For Tourists and Visitors Laser Safety at Laser Maintenance Group In（国内版）/src.py

points.K3: 便装访客：通道畅通，不吊重物
points.K5: 站在看得清又安全的地方

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着导游小旗站在激光加工车间门口
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small tour guide flag at the entrance of a laser workshop.
shots.narration: 这一课教你做一个安全的参观向导。
overlay: 做一个安全的参观向导

shots.scene: 小旗、眼睛、鞋子、黄线、对话气泡五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a guide flag, an eye, a closed shoe, a yellow floor line, and a speech bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 看着装、找站位、防突然、先告知。

shots.scene: 小研带着几位来参观的中学生走进车间，有人穿凉鞋和裙子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads a few visiting high school students into the workshop; some wear sandals and skirts.
shots.narration: 小研第一次当向导，带中学生参观。

shots.scene: 一名访客走到正在吊运钢板的行车下方
shots.prompt_en: A visitor wanders toward an area where an overhead crane is lifting a steel sheet.
shots.narration: 有人一转身，走到了行车下面。

shots.scene: 老李大声提醒，小研赶紧把访客拉回来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer calls out a warning and the female graduate student quickly pulls the visitor back.
shots.narration: 老李喊停，小研赶紧把人拉回来。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 当向导，热情之外还要会防护。

shots.scene: 访客们隔着观察窗看激光切割，脸上很兴奋
shots.prompt_en: Visitors watch laser cutting through a closed viewing window with excited faces.
shots.narration: 参观的人都想看激光，玩得开心。

shots.scene: 一位访客手里拿着一个刚冷却的激光切割小纪念品
shots.prompt_en: A visitor holds a small cooled laser-cut metal souvenir shaped like a star.
shots.narration: 拍点视频、带个小纪念品回家。

shots.scene: 访客回家给朋友讲述的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person at home happily telling friends about the visit. No people.
shots.narration: 回去还能讲给朋友听。

shots.scene: 小研站在访客和机器之间，护着访客
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands between the visitors and the machines, arms slightly out to protect them.
shots.narration: 可向导最重要的事，是保护他们。

shots.scene: 小研一边讲解，一边扫视四周
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student explains while keeping an eye on the surroundings.
shots.narration: 可以展示，但眼睛一直要留心。

shots.section_title: 便装访客：通道畅通，不吊重物
shots.scene: 凉鞋和裙子图标旁，一块钢板从行车上吊过
shots.prompt_en: Icons of sandals and a skirt next to a steel sheet hanging from an overhead crane. No people.
shots.narration: 访客穿凉鞋、裙子，没有防护。
overlay: 便装访客：通道畅通，不吊重物

shots.section_title: 便装访客：通道畅通，不吊重物
shots.scene: 老李把通道上的线缆和板材挪开
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer clears cables and metal sheets out of the walkway.
shots.narration: 通道要清空，不让人磕绊。

shots.section_title: 便装访客：通道畅通，不吊重物
shots.scene: 有访客在场时吊运钢板的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a crane lifting a steel sheet near visitors, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 访客在场时，不卸钢板、不吊重物。

shots.scene: 老李脚上的安全鞋特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the facility engineer's sturdy safety shoes on the workshop floor.
shots.narration: 就算穿着安全鞋，

shots.scene: 一块钢板压在安全鞋上的示意，旁边感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a heavy steel plate dropping onto a safety shoe, with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 也不能保证不受伤。

shots.section_title: 站在看得清又安全的地方
shots.scene: 小研把访客带到黄线围出的参观区
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the visitors into a viewing area marked with yellow floor lines.
shots.narration: 把访客带到安全的位置。
overlay: 站在看得清又安全的地方

shots.section_title: 站在看得清又安全的地方
shots.scene: 访客站在参观区，前面能清楚看到切割机的观察窗
shots.prompt_en: The visitors stand in the viewing area with a clear view of the laser cutting machine's window.
shots.narration: 既能看清楚，又在安全范围里。

shots.scene: 储罐、行车、叉车、带锯四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a cryogenic tank, an overhead crane, a forklift, and a band saw. No people.
shots.narration: 替访客留意会突然启动的设备。

shots.scene: 叉车突然发动，访客吓得一缩
shots.prompt_en: A forklift suddenly starts up nearby and a visitor flinches.
shots.narration: 它们会突然动起来、发出响声。

shots.scene: 受惊的访客往后退的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a startled visitor stepping backward. No people.
shots.narration: 受惊的人，常常会往后乱退。

shots.scene: 老李举手示意，指着带锯对访客说话
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer raises his hand and points at the band saw while talking to the visitors.
shots.narration: 动作之前，先告诉访客要做什么。

shots.scene: 老李指着带锯的出声位置，访客点头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points to where the noise will come from, and the visitors nod.
shots.narration: 指给他们看：从这里响，会这样动。

shots.scene: 带锯启动，访客平静地看着
shots.prompt_en: The band saw starts and the visitors watch calmly.
shots.narration: 心里有数，就不会被吓到。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白访客登记本上签字批准
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs approval in a blank visitor logbook.
shots.narration: 访客进实验室，先登记、经批准。

shots.scene: 小研给访客讲安全须知，访客戴上空白访客牌
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gives a safety briefing as the visitors put on blank visitor badges.
shots.narration: 进门前讲清安全须知。

shots.scene: 访客独自走进车间的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a visitor walking alone into the workshop, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 全程有人陪同，不单独走动。

shots.scene: 通知单图标：封闭鞋、长裤、扎头发
shots.prompt_en: A notice icon showing closed shoes, long pants, and tied-back hair. No people.
shots.narration: 参观前就告诉访客怎么穿。

shots.scene: 小研给访客发护目镜，访客戴上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands out safety glasses and the visitors put them on.
shots.narration: 进门发护目镜，凉鞋访客不进车间。

shots.scene: 激光切割机周围一圈隔离链和激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A barrier chain and a laser warning sign around a laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 激光区有警示和隔离，访客不越线。

shots.scene: 访客隔着观察窗看，没人靠近打开的门
shots.prompt_en: Visitors watch through the closed viewing window; nobody approaches the machine door.
shots.narration: 只隔着观察窗看，不靠近机门。

shots.scene: 访客在参观区举着手机拍摄
shots.prompt_en: A visitor films with a phone from inside the yellow viewing area.
shots.narration: 拍照拍视频，只在参观区里拍。

shots.scene: 举手机挤到操作员身边的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a visitor with a phone crowding next to a machine operator, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不挤到操作员身边，不打扰操作。

shots.scene: 报警灯亮起，小研举起小旗
shots.prompt_en: A red alarm light flashes and the female graduate student raises a guide flag.
shots.narration: 遇到紧急情况，访客跟着向导走。

shots.scene: 小研带访客沿疏散指示走到室外集合点，清点人数
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the visitors along emergency exit signs to an outdoor assembly point and counts them.
shots.narration: 沿疏散通道撤到集合点，清点人数。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现登记本、护目镜、黄线、对话气泡、出口五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five icons: a logbook, safety glasses, a yellow floor line, a speech bubble, and an exit sign.
shots.narration: 登记陪同、穿对戴好、站对位置。

shots.scene: 小研带着戴护目镜的访客站在参观区
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands with visitors wearing safety glasses in the viewing area.
shots.narration: 留心设备、先说再做、不越线。

shots.scene: 欣欣、小研和访客们在车间门口挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student and the visitors wave goodbye at the workshop door.
shots.narration: 开心参观，平安回家。
